sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3.5-4b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 4B Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 4B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens. Highlights Unified Vision-Language Foundation.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 4B by Qwen | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 4B is a 32-layer causal language model with a vision encoder, trained with early text-vision fusion so it handles text and images natively.
